validationScope: Actual paid copy acquisitions and conditional witnessed source components connect to direct-Action payment, RP/cadence, permission consumption, owner-round cap, current provider and shared concentration. Separate Ready lifecycle boundary exercised.

acceptanceCoverage.expectation: Two consecutive Eldritch Echo captures of the same underlying spell identity, even from different source events or with different bounded profile/q choices, share one feat-copy family; the second copy receives the next ordinary Refrain step. Capture event ID does not reset history.
limitations: Different actual capture/profile/feat tested; two Echo captures across a real beneficial rest and varying same-source class rank are not executed.

acceptanceCoverage.expectation: A Mimicry copy and later Arcane Adaptation activation of the same underlying captured spell/effect identity share the same feat-copy family. Changing permission source or casting ability route does not reset Refrain.

An ordinary personally known cast of the underlying spell followed by a feat-copy cast uses two distinct chronological families. The ordinary cast does not grant the copy and does not pre-load the feat-copy Refrain family.
limitations: Ordinary quote/history boundary tested; no full ordinary spell cast/payload transaction here.

acceptanceCoverage.expectation: Two different underlying source spell/effect identities that both map to Strike remain different feat-copy families; common profile ID alone does not merge history.
Strike/Burst/Mend/Step do not displace existing concentration merely because they are feat-copy casts; each resolves immediately.
Ward/Hindrance/Boon displace incompatible prior concentration at commitment. Countering afterward does not restore prior concentration and leaves no copied lasting effect.
A successful lasting Ward/Hindrance/Boon ends immediately on lost concentration even if its stated two-interval/source deadline has not arrived.

Ready preparation already holds concentration. Releasing Ward/Hindrance/Boon continues the same one burden; releasing an immediate profile ends the Ready hold after resolution. No second concentration slot exists.
limitations: Shared concentration lifecycle tested from paid-preparation premise; Ready payment, trigger, Reaction, expiry scheduling and release cap remain unintegrated.

acceptanceCoverage.expectation: Wizard-qualified feat copy does not receive Wizard first-prepared-matrix base-Dissonance exemption and is not a prepared matrix.
Shaman-qualified feat copy inside its own totem aura does not consume or benefit from the ordinary-Shaman-spell vent unless a future source explicitly names feat-copy casts.
limitations: Unsupported actual class routes reject; no Shaman totem or Mirrorsage shared allowance engine executed.

acceptanceCoverage.expectation: Mirrorsage qualification does not import class Echo Release first-release Refrain waiver; the feat copy still consumes the shared release allowance only where its exact existing source says so.
limitations: Unsupported actual class routes reject; no Shaman totem or Mirrorsage shared allowance engine executed.

acceptanceCoverage.expectation: At PB3 and casting modifier +3, feat-copy Limit is max(4,6+3)=9. Ordinary class spell Limit under the separate integration formula would be max(4,2+3+3)=8; this difference is intentional scoped authority, not a global correction.
Feat-only Eldritch Blast route can qualify q0 with CHA; it cannot establish q1+ ceiling, a class engine, Wizard/Mirrorsage/Shaman protections, or another RP pool.

openWork: Recipient damage/healing/buffer/control/movement payloads and real world clocks.
Full Shaman and Mirrorsage qualification and class shared-release allowance integration.
Full Ready payment/action/trigger/Reaction/expiry transaction; concentration boundary alone is implemented.
Actual price modifiers, world suppression/dispels and executable game-engine integration.

queuedSourceIssue.status: Question for actual GPT; no new rule selected
queuedSourceIssue.question: FS-08 casts and pays Ready at preparation, while SUP-07 caps one feat-copy release per owner per numbered round and Mimicry consumes a failed/countered release. For a held feat-copy prepared in round N and released in N+1, identify an existing exact ruling or specify when the owner-round allowance (and an actually owned Mirrorsage shared allowance) is checked/reserved/spent, including countered preparation, failed/lost hold and a competing direct release. Do not infer a new timing from the lifecycle-only adapter.
queuedSourceIssue.context: Direct Action commitment reserves its round; Ready is deliberately not accepted by that adapter. Concentration-only tests begin from an already-paid preparation premise.

limits: World source completion, perception, capture geometry, action frames, selection legality and magic/component predicates remain conditional scenario premises.
Only the actual Wizard and paid rank-zero Blast credential routes are connected. Shaman/Mirrorsage and other providers, shared class release caps and priced modifiers are not implemented.
Recipient HP/damage/healing/movement/buffer/control effects, real world deadlines, suppression/dispel, save-load and live engine behavior are not executed by this release adapter.
Concentration effectActive is a lifecycle record, not evidence of an actual recipient modifier or successful target resolution.
Ready starts from already-paid preparation; no complete Ready transaction or owner-round cap timing is claimed.
Source-bound finite tests do not approve the 335 feats, numerical balance, human gameplay, cosmology canon, publication or whole game.
